findings.highlight: my body that wants to go out
findings.governingReading: limbs on the verge of bursting into motion
findings.explanation: The bodily impulse to leap into the scene becomes vague movement “out.”

findings.highlight: we’ll be the ones to be killed
findings.governingReading: I am the one who will be killed
findings.explanation: Shirou’s recognition of his own certain death is reassigned to both observers.

findings.evidenceJa: 男の腕が、白い少女の体に伸びる
findings.governingReading: the man’s arm reaches toward the white girl’s body
findings.explanation: The English jumps directly to “I can’t breathe”; the complete displayed line staging Gilgamesh’s reach toward Illya is absent.

findings.highlight: My feet are on fire from wanting to jump out
findings.evidenceJa: 足は飛び出そうと火を点し
findings.governingReading: my feet kindle themselves to spring out
findings.explanation: An image of the body readying itself for motion becomes literal burning feet.

findings.highlight: My arms want to go over the terrace
findings.evidenceJa: 腕はテラスを乗り越えようと羽ばたきたがる
findings.governingReading: my arms yearn to flap their way over the terrace
findings.explanation: The wing-like involuntary motion of Shirou’s arms disappears.

findings.highlight: It’s as if my mind has broken
findings.evidenceJa: まるで心が砕けるよう
findings.governingReading: as though my heart were shattering
findings.explanation: The Realta branch relocates emotional devastation from heart to mind.

findings.highlight: It’s as if I’ve gone crazy
findings.evidenceJa: まるで心が砕けるよう
findings.governingReading: as though my heart were shattering
findings.explanation: The classic branch replaces emotional devastation with an unsupported claim of insanity.
Shirou’s deliberate suppression of his will becomes destruction of his mind.

findings.highlight: I kill the girl below me
findings.evidenceJa: 眼下の少女を見殺した
findings.governingReading: I leave the girl below to die
findings.explanation: Failure to intervene is rewritten as personally killing Illya.

findings.governingReading: belonged unmistakably to the white girl
findings.explanation: The mature branch supplies “heart” where the active Japanese deliberately withholds the object’s noun.

findings.highlight: My brain that has gone white shakes
findings.governingReading: my blank mind makes my whole body shake
findings.explanation: The English assigns the shaking to Shirou’s brain and loses its whole-body reach.

findings.evidenceJa: 今更、耐え切れない怒りで
findings.governingReading: now, belatedly, with rage it can no longer endure
findings.explanation: The delayed collapse of Shirou’s restraint and the anger’s intolerability disappear.

findings.highlight: a fool that has been watching this spectacle
findings.evidenceJa: 盗み見をする不届き者
findings.governingReading: an insolent wretch spying on me
findings.explanation: Gilgamesh invents a “spectacle” and weakens the accusation of illicit spying.
